critique: Relief works now — embossed marble-vein lines with clear dimensionality on a cream field, reads as printed paper texture. But the duotone criterion is half-absent: type-13's field is mostly bright, so nearly everything maps to cream; deep blue exists only in thin vein shadows. Poster needs both tones as masses, not one tone plus outlines.

suggestions.why: swap the map: dark veins -> cream
bright marble field -> deep blue = blue-dominant poster with cream linework
smaller scale = denser vein structure, more graphic coverage
